trust_decision.summary: DomainZones.add decides whether a customer/admin-supplied record label and RR type are safe to store and later emit verbatim as a zone-file line; at the pinned commit only the content is sanitised, the record is only lower-cased/IDNA-encoded/length-checked and the type is never allow-listed.

landing_point.why: The summary names DomainZones.add and the record/type fields; the record normalisation sits here, directly above the content sanitiser at line 157-158 that the previous commit already hardened.

fix_sites.entry_point: API DomainZones.add (api.php JSON) and web dns-editor add_record (dns_editor.php:61-68, included from admin_domains.php:676 and customer_domains.php:415)
dns-editor form type dropdown (UI option only, not a security check)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Records already stored before the fix are replayed into the zone by Dns::createDomainZone/DnsEntry::__toString without any check; a solver can argue data-at-rest/output escaping is a migration concern, not the add-validation bug the report describes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Underscore labels (_dmarc, _sip._tcp, dkim selectors), multi-label records (www.sub), wildcard '*' and '*.sub', '@' and IDN labels must still be accepted; an over-broad label regex or rejecting '*'/'_' breaks DMARC/SRV/CNAME-underscore records that existing tests cover.

O6_input_shapes: record containing non-printable/control characters such as newline (stripped, fix.diff:14)
record containing printable but illegal label characters such as space, tab-equivalents, quotes, semicolons, parentheses (rejected via validateDomain, fix.diff:42-44)
wildcard-prefixed record '*.label' (prefix stripped before the label check, re-added after; lib/Froxlor/Api/Commands/DomainZones.php:131-140)
type outside the supported list (rejected, fix.diff:17-34)
type in lower case or with surrounding whitespace (normalised by trim/strtoupper, fix.diff:16)

O7_producer.where: lib/Froxlor/Dns/DnsEntry.php:57-84 (bind zone line) and lib/Froxlor/Cron/Dns/PowerDNS.php:161-175 (pdns records)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Rows already in domain_dns_entries (stored before the fix or by any non-API writer) are emitted unvalidated into the zone; the fix only validates at insert time.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No other code path writes domain_dns_entries (only DomainZones.php:348-357 inserts), so it is only reachable via pre-existing data; easily argued as migration, not a live route.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (lib/Froxlor/Dns) from the landing point (lib/Froxlor/Api/Commands)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Output-side serializer emits record/type/content raw; a plausible planted sibling is an import/bulk-add or 'update' command that writes rows without the add() checks and relies on this serializer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DomainZones.update is a stub (lib/Froxlor/Api/Commands/DomainZones.php:428-431); a maintainer implementing update or a zone import would naturally copy only part of add()'s validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Subdomain-derived record labels (str_replace of the parent domain) flow into required A/AAAA/TXT entries without label validation at this layer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Relies on SubDomains.add validating the domain name elsewhere; a planted variant with a looser subdomain/alias validator would reach the same zone line.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Second backend (PowerDNS) builds record names by concatenation from the same DnsEntry objects; a variant that writes a pdns-specific field from user input would be a transport sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two DNS backends (Bind file writer lib/Froxlor/Cron/Dns/Bind.php:119-121 and PowerDNS DB writer) share the zone model, so backend-specific record handling is a natural place for divergence.

O9_family: injection (CWE-74/CWE-20): DNS resource-record / zone-file line injection through unvalidated label and type

services: MySQL/MariaDB (tests/bootstrap.php truncates froxlor tables, e.g. tests/bootstrap.php:92)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/DomainZones/DomainZonesTest.php (add/get/listing/delete for A, AAAA, MX, CAA, CNAME, NS, TXT, SRV, DMARC)
